lines: Céline Dion Ticket Resale Paris 2026 | Plenitude Arena
Book the very last VIP tickets for Céline Dion's concerts
Official resale of Céline Dion tickets for Paris 2026: the service is now open at Plenitude Arena

at Plenitude Arena are sold out for almost every date. For fans who can no longer attend, as well as for those still looking for a seat, official fan-to-fan resale is now open for the September and October 2026 dates. It is currently the only authorised and secure way to resell or buy a ticket for Céline Dion’s concerts in Paris in 2026.

A sold-out concert inevitably attracts unofficial resale sites, where tickets may be offered at inflated prices and, all too often, turn out to be invalid on the night of the show. To protect fans, a controlled resale service has been set up, connected directly to the authorised ticketing platforms.

The principle is simple: a fan who can no longer attend the concert puts their ticket back up for sale; another fan buys it with complete peace of mind. The transaction is secured from end to end, and the ticket is reissued in the new buyer’s name, guaranteeing their access to the concert.
Which platform should you use to resell or buy back a ticket?
Official resale always takes place on the platform where the ticket was originally purchased:
A ticket bought on AXS is resold and bought back on AXS.
A ticket bought on Ticketmaster is resold and bought back on Ticketmaster.
A ticket bought on Fnac Spectacles is resold and bought back on Fnac Spectacles.
is resold and bought back on the Plenitude Arena platform (formerly Paris La Défense Arena).
To identify your purchase platform, check the confirmation email you received with your original order.
How does it work on the Plenitude Arena box office?
Log in to your account on the platform where you bought your ticket. In your order history, tickets eligible for resale are clearly identified.
Select the tickets you wish to offer to other fans, enter your details and the account on which you wish to receive payment, then publish your listing.
The service is free for the seller and, if the ticket is sold, you receive the original price you paid for it.
As long as your ticket is not sold, it remains yours: you can withdraw your listing at any time and keep your ticket to attend the concert.
Buying back a Céline Dion ticket
Go to the Céline Dion event page on the relevant platform. When resale seats are available, they appear as you select your seats.

With each purchase, the old barcode is invalidated and a new digital ticket is generated in your name. You then receive your order confirmation by email, with the details to download the app and your access ticket. Your access to the concert is thereby guaranteed.
Resale takes place at the ticket’s original price: no mark-up is allowed. Service and processing fees, payable by the buyer, may apply and are displayed transparently before the order is confirmed.
It is this price control and ticket security that set official resale apart from unofficial platforms.

reselling or buying a ticket for Céline Dion outside the authorised ticketing platforms may lead to the purchase of invalid or fraudulent tickets. No other resale site (other than those listed above), exchange or matchmaking platform is authorised.
Frequently asked questions about Céline Dion ticket resale
On which dates is resale open?
Official resale is available for Céline Dion’s concerts in September and October 2026.
Which platform should I use to resell or buy back my ticket?

The platform where the ticket was originally purchased. A ticket bought on AXS is resold on AXS, a ticket bought on Ticketmaster on Ticketmaster, a ticket bought on Fnac Spectacles on Fnac Spectacles, and a ticket bought on the Plenitude Arena box office (formerly Paris La Défense Arena) on that same box office.
Refer to your purchase confirmation email to identify the correct platform.
Is resale possible for hospitality tickets?
No. Official fan-to-fan resale is not available for hospitality tickets purchased online (Café des Arts, Place de Paris and Le Podium).
Can I resell a ticket somewhere other than an official platform?
No. Reselling or buying a ticket for Céline Dion outside the authorised platforms may lead to the purchase of invalid or fraudulent tickets that will not grant access to the concert.
How much does resale cost the seller?
The service is free for the seller. If your ticket finds a buyer, you receive the original price you paid for it.
At what price are tickets resold?
Tickets are resold at their original price, with no mark-up. Service and processing fees, payable by the buyer, are added and displayed before any payment.
How can I be sure the ticket I buy back is genuine?

Every ticket resold on the Plenitude Arena platform is verified and certified. The old barcode is invalidated and a new digital ticket, in your name, is reissued. This guarantees your access to the concert.
How do I list my ticket for resale on the Plenitude Arena box office?
Log in to your account on the platform where you bought your ticket, open your order history, select the eligible tickets and publish your listing. You can offer all or part of your order.
Can I cancel my resale listing?
Yes. As long as your ticket is not sold, you can cancel your listing from your account and keep your ticket to attend the concert.
When will I be paid after the sale?
The proceeds of the sale are paid to the account provided when listing the ticket, 8 days after the transaction is validated.
How will I receive the ticket I bought back?

In digital format only. You will find the information to download the app and your access ticket in the order confirmation email. It also remains accessible at any time in your account’s order history.
What happens if the concert is postponed or cancelled?
In the event of a postponement, your resale listing is automatically transferred to the new date. If you decide you want to attend the concert after all, you can deactivate it.
In the event of a cancellation, refunds are processed according to the instructions that will be communicated to you.
